description: This Java class 'TabHelperEclair' provides a backward-compatible way to manage tabs with fragments in Android pre-Honeycomb devices. It extends a base 'TabHelper' class and implements tab switching logic with fragment transactions, handling tab events and saving/restoring state.

classes.name: TabHelperEclair
classes.description: A helper class for managing tabs with fragments in pre-Honeycomb Android devices, facilitating fragment switching, tab state management, and compatibility handling.

classes.name: DummyTabFactory
classes.description: A dummy implementation of TabContentFactory used to create placeholder views for tabs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the TabHost and sets its tab change listener.

methods.name: addTab
methods.description: Adds a new tab to the TabHost, managing existing fragments associated with the tab.

methods.name: onTabChanged
methods.description: Handles tab switch events, performing fragment transactions and notifying callback listeners.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current tab for state restoration during configuration changes.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the previously selected tab after a configuration change.
